subject: oprimizing file write, read from shiny

messages.author: b1c85aa4fa464db9
messages.subject: oprimizing file write, read from shiny
parts:
I have a large, pre-processed file to be read at beginning of a shiny app.  

stringsAsFactors=TRUE is important to reduce file size and read time  (read time being more important than file size)

I am wondering of the optimal file write function (at final preprocessing) that would enable the fasted file read from a shiny app?

I assume (but not sure) that data.table::fread() is the fastest read from a shiny app?

Thanks for advice on which write function and read function I should use to minimize file size and shiny app read time.
